item.title: Thousands march across Edmund Pettus Bridge in honor of Bloody Sunday
item.description: SELMA, Ala. (WIAT) -- On March 7, 1965, hundreds of peaceful protestors marched across the Edmund Pettus Bridge in Selma. item.title: UAB pulmonologist discusses health impact of daylight saving time
item.description: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. (WIAT) -- Many Americans will lose an hour of sleep this weekend as clocks spring forward for daylight saving time, and doctors say the shift can temporarily affect our health. While many people enjoy the longer daylight hours in the evening, sleep experts say the sudden change can disrupt the body’s natural rhythm. [...]

item.title: Decades after violence in Selma spurred the Voting Rights Act, organizers worry about its fate
item.description: Sixty-one years after state troopers attacked Civil Rights marchers on the Edmund Pettus Bridge in Selma, thousands are gathering in the Alabama city this weekend, amid new concerns about the future of the Voting Rights Act.
